# BABESIA SPECIES

Consult Infectious Diseases in all cases.

# Duration of antimicrobial therapy

Treat for 7-10 days. If patient has persistent relapsing disease, treat for 6

weeks including 2 weeks after babesia are no longer detected in blood smear.

# Treatment of mild to moderate disease

[Azithromycin 500 mg PO once on day 1, then 250 mg PO q24h \($\) O for 6](orz-set-abx-azithro-500-then-250-q24h-atovaquone-750-q12h)

days <AND> atovaquone 750 mg PO q12h ($) [M] for 7 days

Alternative

*Consult Infectious Diseases, requires NF consult for quinine.

Clindamycin 600 mg PO q8h <AND> quinine 650 mg PO q8h

# Treatment of severe disease

[Azithromycin 500 IV q24h \($\) M <AND> atovaquone 750 mg PO q12h \($\) M](orz-set-abx-azithro-500mg-iv-q24h-atova-750mg-po-q12h)

Alternative

*Consult Infectious diseases, requires NF consult for quinine.

Clindamycin 600mg IV q6h <AND> quinine 650 mg PO q8h

References:

Mandell chapter: Babesia Species

Sanford keyword: Babesiosis

Up-to-Date article: Babesiosis: Treatment and prevention

Vannier et al. N Engl J Med. 2012 (366)2397-407
